story.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs

draft:
I just read about a concerning vulnerability in proprietary LLM APIs. 
Researchers have found a way to steal reasoning traces, which could compromise model integrity. 
This raises questions about data security in AI development. 
What steps can we take to protect our models from such attacks?
#LLM #AIsecurity #MachineLearning
